name: boniforce-credit-check
description: Create live company, financial, and sector-aware credit intelligence for German companies.

interface.longDescription: Automatically combine Boniforce company scores, credit-limit recommendations, balance-sheet trends, financial ratios, and company details with matched SectorBench industry health, momentum, insolvencies, and current drivers. The workflow reuses recent reports before spending 75 credits and presents a visual decision brief with transparent sector-match confidence.
defaultPrompt: Get the current Boniscore for this German company.
Assess this company and compare its risk with its SectorBench industry.
Create a visual credit brief with financial and sector trends.
